posts.cooked:
The magical supercomputers that host GreaterThanGames.com (and associated domains) has been upgraded. As part of this, we've also upgraded some of the software that runs the site.

If you notice anything, please PM me, cajunjoel, and I'll take a look as soon as I can.

Why you ask? Omnitron told us to. Really. We do what it says. Would you argue with a sentient robotics factory? 

Benefits: More capacity! A faster site! Less downtime when uh, amazingly awesome kickstarters are announced! Yeah, that.
